payload.title: Add typed biblicus.api request and response models for the Papyrus commands
payload.description:
## Goal
Give Papyrus a stable, typed contract instead of ad hoc JSON over a subprocess.

## Work (after the curation surface lands, blbs-12b984)
Add a `biblicus.api` module with one Pydantic request model and one response model per command Papyrus calls: `taxonomy discover/record`, `steering export/artifacts/graph-signals/render-seed-manifest`, `topic-classifier train/project`, `analyze topic-context/topic-trends`, `context-pack build-blocks`, `summarize map-reduce`, `extract url-text/article-text/web-metadata`, `query`, `reindex`, `graph extract`. Each has a plain Python function. The CLI becomes a thin wrapper over those functions and prints the response model as JSON. Specs first. Validation errors must be clear.

Papyrus call sites for reference: `newsroom.py` `_run_biblicus`, `curation_cycle.py` `run_biblicus`, `reference_url_text.py`, `reference_curation_signals.py`, `accession.py`.

## Done when
Every command Papyrus calls has typed models, a JSON schema is published in docs, and the CLI output validates against it in a feature scenario.
